faq.title: Skilled craftsman : how does it work ?

q1.title: How to find a competent craftsman on Artisan-Compétent?
q1.p1: Finding a service provider on Artisan-Compétent is simple, fast and fully digital.
q1.intro: After signing up, you just need to:

steps.item1: choose the trade you need (plumbing, electricity, masonry...)
steps.item3: explain your need via a short video, photos or text

q1.p2: Your request is sent to qualified professionals and/or competent individuals matching your criteria. You receive several proposals to compare and choose transparently.

items.escrow1: Escrow payment: the entire quote up to €5,000 is held.
items.escrow2: Above €5,000, only labor is held (except manufacturer artisans, case by case).
items.tracking: Digital worksite tracking: photos, comments and steps in real time.
items.cmod: CMOD: an independent professional advises and intervenes in case of doubt or dispute.
items.abuse: Protection against abuses: possible intervention (within 12 to 48 hours) in case of a night-time (emergency) signed and paid quote that is clearly excessive (even after the digital report is validated within a maximum of 48 hours, please report from your dashboard).
items.pv: Digital report: no payment released without formal validation.

q3.title: What if I paid but the craftsman did not intervene?

items.escrow: Funds are held in escrow: the provider cannot be paid.
items.report: You can immediately report via your dashboard.
items.review: CMOD and admins review the case.
items.refund: Full refund if no intervention occurred within the timeframe stated in the quote; Artisan‑Compétent covers the escrow fees for you!

q4.title: Why use Artisan-Compétent only for small jobs and emergencies?

items.neutral: Neutral contact in case of issue (CMOD + platform).

q4.p: Artisan-Compétent turns a stressful situation into a secure, controlled process.

q5.title: What VAT rate applies in France for renovation works?

items.rate55: 5.5%: energy efficiency improvements (insulation, heat pumps, etc.).

q5.note: Reduced rates apply to dwellings built over 2 years ago and may cover labor and supplies if provided by the professional.
q5.advice: It's often better to let the professional supply and install; self-purchased materials are at 20%.

q6.title: What are the guidelines/obligations for providers?

items.goals: Artisan-Compétent reduces prospecting, eliminates unpaid invoices, secures payments and professionalizes client relations.
items.cmodShare: Of these 20%, 5% goes to the CMOD.

q7.title: What are the guidelines/obligations for clients?
q7.intro: To secure payments, protect all parties and avoid disputes, each client using the Artisan‑Compétent platform commits to a clear and transparent operating framework.

pay.title: Regarding payment and supplies
pay.upTo5000: For interventions whose total amount is less than or equal to €5,000, the full quote amount (labor and supplies) can be held in escrow on the platform until the final acceptance report is validated.
pay.laborOnly: However, to better fit real-world constraints, you may also choose, up to €5,000, to escrow only the labor portion on the platform.
pay.laborOnlyWhy: This option can be useful when the craftsman cannot advance materials (for example, when suppliers do not grant payment terms). It can also help limit escrow-related fees, which may be passed on to the craftsman from certain amounts.
pay.optionsIntro: In that case, several options are possible:

options.li1: you can go with the craftsman to the supplier and pay the materials directly,
options.li2: the craftsman can also go alone, advance the cost of supplies, then be reimbursed by you once the materials are delivered and on site.

pay.advanceNote: In this setup, reimbursement for supplies advanced by the craftsman may occur as soon as they are delivered, without waiting for the final acceptance report. Escrow then remains limited to the labor portion, which is released once the work is validated.
pay.above5000: For projects above €5,000, only labor is held in escrow on the platform, for the same reasons mentioned above.
pay.directSupplier: Supplies must be paid directly to the supplier, ideally with the craftsman present.
pay.discourageDirectArtisan: Paying materials directly to the craftsman is strongly discouraged, except in clearly framed and justified exceptional situations.

obl.title: Your obligations as a client

items.req: submit a clear, precise and honest request regarding your work,
items.insurance: verify the craftsman's professional insurance (professional liability and/or 10‑year warranty) by contacting the insurer directly to confirm coverage for the work to be carried out,
items.tracking: track work progress, ideally on site and, if needed, via your dedicated dashboard,
items.report: report any problem, doubt or disagreement immediately (contact CMOD only in case of dispute or concrete suspicion of fraud),

obl.noteInsurance: Even if Artisan‑Compétent performs these checks upstream, coverage can change over time for various reasons, or certain specific works may not be included in the policy.

items.cancelGuarantees: cancellation of all guarantees provided by the platform,
items.cmodImpossible: impossibility for CMOD to intervene in case of dispute.

pv.title: Project validation
pv.text: The final acceptance report is mandatory to release funds. Without formal validation of this document, no payment can be made.

q7.goal: These rules have a simple goal: protect you, prevent abuses and ensure a secure, transparent and smooth experience for all parties.

q8.title: What is an CMOD?

items.indep: Independent construction professional, no link to the site provider.
items.role1: Helps you with technical understanding and quote analysis.
items.role2: Intervenes in case of doubt, misunderstanding or dispute.

q8.note: The CMOD is not a site manager and does not intervene physically. It's a guarantee of safety and neutrality.

meta.title: Artisan Compétent Partner Program | 20% Commission
meta.description: Recommend Artisan Compétent to your audience and earn 20% commission the first year. Free signup, no commitment, no upfront cost.

hero.subtitle: Recommend the platform that puts an end to construction scams. Earn 20% commission the first year. No long-term contract, no commitment, no upfront cost.

howItWorks.title: Three steps, that's it.
howItWorks.step1Body: Free signup, no minimum audience required. You receive a unique affiliate link and a short code, both tied to your partner account. That's how your referrals are tracked.
howItWorks.step2Title: Talk about Artisan Compétent to your audience.
howItWorks.step2Body: To your family, your followers, your clients, your network. Video, post, story, word of mouth — your call. The only rule: at least one piece of content per week, so we know you're active (and so your audience keeps you in mind).
howItWorks.step3Body: When the person you referred takes action and the work is completed (handover certificate signed), your commission is validated. Quarterly bank transfer, PDF receipt available in your partner dashboard.

commissions.title: It's simple. Really.
commissions.summaryClient: You refer a client: 20% the first year, 10% the second.
commissions.summaryArtisan: You refer a professional: 5% on their jobs.
commissions.summaryBoth: You do both: you stack, up to 25%.
commissions.detailsTitle: The details if you need them
commissions.detailClient: Individual client: 20% commission on Artisan Compétent's margin the first year after the client's signup, 10% the second year. After 24 months, the commission ends.
commissions.detailArtisan: Referred professional: 5% on the margin generated by jobs signed through this professional, as long as they remain active on the platform.
commissions.detailCumul: Stacking: if you bring in both a client and a professional, you earn on both. The same person can therefore earn up to 25% on a single job (20% on the client side + 5% on the professional side).
commissions.condition1: Attribution cookie valid for 365 days after the first click on your link. This is the maximum duration allowed by GDPR.
commissions.condition2: On top of the cookie, your referral is tied to your partner account at the time of signup. This lets you earn commissions beyond 365 days, within the limits of the grid.
commissions.condition3: You must publish at least one piece of content per week. After 14 days without publication, you receive a warning. After 21 days, your link is suspended. Conversions registered before suspension are kept and paid normally.
commissions.condition4: Commissions only apply to Artisan Compétent's margin. Never on materials, never on the labor billed by the professional.
commissions.condition5: Quarterly bank transfer, starting from the handover certificate signed by the client. No payment on signed quote alone, because a quote can still be cancelled mid-job.

whyRecommend.title: You're not selling a product. You're selling protection.
whyRecommend.intro: Recommending Artisan Compétent isn't pushing yet another offer. It's telling your audience: here's how to put an end to inflated quotes, vanishing professionals, and botched jobs that you have to pay for anyway.
whyRecommend.arg1: Escrow protection: the client's money is only released to the professional after the work is validated. That speaks to everyone.
whyRecommend.arg2: Professionals are verified (business registration, public liability insurance, ten-year warranty). No shady profiles.
whyRecommend.arg3: C-MOD remote support covers jobs at distance for clients who can't be on site.
whyRecommend.arg4: Signup is free for both clients and professionals. No barrier to entry.
whyRecommend.outro: If your audience includes homeowners, renters who want to renovate, condo owners, or simply people who are afraid of getting ripped off on a job, you have a natural audience for Artisan Compétent.

badge.title: For registered professionals, a trust signal that speaks to clients.
badge.body1: If you're a professional and you join Artisan Compétent, you receive an official "Anti-scam Certified" badge to display on your website, social media, and quotes. This badge confirms that you're verified, that your insurance is up to date, and that your jobs are covered by escrow protection.
badge.body2: For your clients, this badge changes the game: they know they're protected before even signing. Our goal is for it to become a standard of trust in the French construction industry, the way the RGE or Qualibat labels are today for energy efficiency.
badge.note: The badge is granted to professionals registered on the platform and cannot be used for jobs handled outside Artisan Compétent. That's what guarantees its value.

expectations.title: No magic, no promises. Just consistency.
expectations.exp1: At least one publication per week mentioning Artisan Compétent: video, post, story, podcast, or article.
expectations.exp2: One proof to upload each week in your partner dashboard (screenshot or link). Takes 30 seconds.
expectations.exp3: Respect for the legal framework: no lying about what the platform is, no overselling what it does. Transparency is our hallmark, and we expect the same from our partners.
expectations.exp4: Normal use of your link: no spam, no purchase of unqualified traffic, no cookie fraud. Any manipulation triggers immediate suspension without notice.
expectations.note: We don't ask for minimum numbers, no KPI to hit. The only rule is consistency. If you publish every week, you stay in the program, whether you make 2 signups or 200.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need a large audience to join the program?
faq.a1: No. The program is open to everyone, no minimum threshold. A friend who tells 5 people about Artisan Compétent can generate a commission. We prefer 100 active and consistent partners over 10 large passive audiences.
faq.q2: When do I get my commission?
faq.a2: When the job is finished. Concretely: your referral signs their quote, the work is done, they sign the handover certificate, and that's when your commission is validated. Payment is quarterly by bank transfer.
faq.q3: Why not when the quote is signed?
faq.a3: Because a quote can still be cancelled mid-job (issue, accident, disagreement), in which case the client is refunded via escrow. On a signed handover certificate, it's clean: the work is done, the money is released, your commission is due.
faq.q4: What happens if I stop publishing?
faq.a4: Don't worry. If more than 14 days go by without proof of content, you receive a warning. After 21 days, your affiliate link is suspended. Conversions registered before suspension are kept and paid normally. You can reactivate your link at any time by resuming activity.
faq.q5: What if the person I referred takes time to take action?
faq.a5: You have 365 days after the first click for the conversion to be attributed to your link (legal GDPR limit for the cookie). But on top of the cookie, your referral is tied to your partner account at signup, so we can keep paying you beyond 365 days within the limits of the grid.
faq.q6: Can I combine this program with other affiliations?
faq.a6: Yes, no problem. The only case where we cut the link is if you simultaneously recommend a direct competitor of Artisan Compétent (another platform with escrow).
faq.q7: Can I refer my own clients or friends?
faq.a7: Yes, as long as the person you refer actually uses the platform for a real job. Referring close contacts without a real project is considered cookie fraud and triggers suspension.
faq.a8: You enter your IBAN in your partner dashboard. Payment is automatic by bank transfer every quarter. A PDF receipt is generated and downloadable from your dashboard.
faq.q9: What do I have to declare for taxes?
faq.a9: Commissions are income to be declared. Depending on your status, the tax regime differs. Artisan Compétent provides an annual summary of amounts paid. We recommend consulting a tax advisor if you exceed €2,000 in commissions per year.

legal.title: Legal notice and program conditions
legal.item1: The partner program is open to adult individuals and to legal entities established in France or the European Union.
legal.item2: Commissions are calculated on Artisan Compétent's net margin and paid quarterly, subject to the handover certificate being signed by the referral.
legal.item3: The cookie attribution period is 365 days maximum, in line with CNIL recommendations. The partner account link allows compensation to extend beyond the cookie, within the limits of the current grid.
legal.item4: Artisan Compétent reserves the right to suspend or terminate access to the program in case of breach of the rules of use (fraud, spam, inappropriate content, non-compliance with regulations).
legal.item5: Changes to the commission grid apply only to new signups; conversions already registered remain compensated according to the conditions in force at the time of the original click.
legal.item6: Any dispute falls under French jurisdiction.
